'''Varrak''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|SOB]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] who worked for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Agent Varrak worked for [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], who had full confidence in her abilities. She was sent to help [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to forge fake IDs for their mission to [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]].
